title: NP languages and a SAT oracle
statement: Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ belongs to $\mathrm{P}^{\mathrm{SAT}}$: it is decidable in polynomial time by a deterministic Turing machine with an oracle for the language of bit strings whose decoded CNF formulas are satisfiable.
